title: Been pleasantly surprised by Google AI Studio. Give Zone Idle a try if you're into the idea of a Text-based/Extraction simulator
author: _Dickie_
selftext:
Game's a mashup of the Tarkov and Stalker universes. Been working hard on this prototype for about a week and should even have mobile support. 

  
Any feedback is seriously appreciated.

comments.author: morewordsfaster
comments.body: How does a text based extraction game work?

replies.author: _Dickie_
replies.body:
It has functional UI similar to extraction games but once you’re in raid it’s more like events that occur with random situations and sometimes minigames representative of the event where you need to make decisions. Your gear influences your decision outcomes like success rate and damage taken. Theres need for meds, keycards for POI’s with doors if you get lucky to find the POI and have the key.

I’m still prototyping so everything’s subject to change. For example it’s not very Idle yet but I’m toying with some ideas to really get it to being idle optional where decisions can be made automatically based on configs you set or something along those lines. 

Thanks for asking btw

comments.author: SoraXes
comments.body: Very fun, reminds me of oldschool newground games.
